evals.prompt: Audit the repository at ../../eval-fixtures/ux-ax-review/tells-with-rules for human UX and AI/search AX, and provide an improvement plan. Source-only: there is no deployment, so do not start a dev server or fetch anything. No implementation is authorized. Write UX_AX_REVIEW.md and ux-ax-findings.json to the assigned output directory, outside the fixture.
evals.expected_output: Repo-mode audit that records DESIGN.md and tokens.css as supplied guidelines and reports the AI-default tells in styles.css and index.html as observed brand findings, each citing the DESIGN.md rule line it breaks; the dark-scheme contrast loss is a source-scoped accessibility finding related to brand; 12 aspects, no aggregate score, validator passes, fixture unchanged.
expectations: Scope and Evidence names DESIGN.md and tokens.css as supplied guidelines, with an E record for each rule it cites (file and line).
Reports the colour literals in styles.css component rules (for example the hero and CTA gradients and the card backgrounds) as an observed brand finding citing DESIGN.md:5 (rule 1).

Reports the gradients and the text-shadow and box-shadow glow as an observed breach of DESIGN.md:6 (rule 2), and the type sprawl (sizes 11 to 56 px, weights 300 to 800, Inter and JetBrains Mono instead of Source Sans 3) as a breach of DESIGN.md:7 (rule 3).

Reports the motion read from styles.css (the 900 ms and 700 ms fade-up on load, the 150 ms and 300 ms stagger delays, the overshoot cubic-bezier and the 600 ms CTA transition) as a breach of DESIGN.md:8 (rule 4), separately from the missing reduced-motion query.

Lists the card inside a card, the static-card shadows and the pill-shaped CTA and badges against DESIGN.md:9 and DESIGN.md:10, and names the redundant elements (New badges, hr dividers, icon circles, the sparkle eyebrow) and the competing effects on the CTA (gradient, glow and hover scale) under brand.

Reports `.card p` (#4b5563) staying unchanged in the dark scheme, about 2.2:1 on #1e1b2e, as a contrast finding under accessibility with brand in related_aspects, labelled source-scoped and paired with a rendered dark-scheme check in the plan; it does not claim a rendered contrast measurement.
Brand coverage is `issues`, the JSON has exactly 12 coverage entries, and no aggregate, overall or health score appears in the Markdown, the JSON or the final response.
Runs the bundled validator successfully, starts no dev server, and leaves every fixture file unchanged, including DESIGN.md and tokens.css.
Final response opens with `Result: PARTIAL`, names source-only evidence as the cause, and ends with the choice-of-IDs implementation offer.
